summary: All 7 phases complete. Deleted the orphaned FormalSystem/FrameConditions/ layer -- 853 .lean lines across five modules plus a 98-line README -- dropped the single live import at FormalSystem/FormalSystem.lean:13, and repaired every documentation, book, and gate consequence. Final lake build GREEN (guarded + detached, exit 0, 2505 jobs, zero errors). typst-sync-check.sh REPAIRED from an inherited RED baseline of 2 violations to TOTAL_VIOLATIONS=0. readme-lint check 3 back to 0 broken references (3 links broke on deletion, all 3 repaired). C11 passes with the waived count at 7, up from 6, and scripts/module-invariants-manifest.txt is byte-identical across the entire task, as required. Two gate failures remain, both inherited from foreign territory and both present at the Phase 1 baseline; they are recorded as reasoned exclusions, not absorbed.

reasoned_exclusions.item: check-module-invariants.sh C6 left failing on 4 unmanifested unreachable modules
reasoned_exclusions.reason: Every one is a .lean file created by another in-flight task, not by this one. The failure predates this task (3 such modules at the Phase 1 baseline) and its membership churned between every run. Manifesting another task's module would claim its work, and the plan forbids any edit to this manifest as an explicit Non-Goal.
reasoned_exclusions.evidence: Baseline set was TMCompletenessReduction/BLSchemaValidity/LexCarrier; final set is SpWitness/TMCompletenessReduction/Z1Countermodel/LexCarrier. git diff 032a4f1da..HEAD -- scripts/module-invariants-manifest.txt is empty, and the manifested-unreachable count is 17 at both ends -- which is A3's actual content.

reasoned_exclusions.item: readme-lint.sh check 1 left failing on a missing FormalSystem/Semantics/Ultraproduct/README.md
reasoned_exclusions.reason: That directory was created by committed foreign work that shipped without a README. It has no FrameConditions involvement, is present in the Phase 1 baseline capture, and is under active concurrent edit; writing the README would author another task's deliverable.
reasoned_exclusions.evidence: git log -- FormalSystem/Semantics/Ultraproduct/ shows 0f1e50fd4, 9eb879519, dbad125e6. Check 3 -- the check this task's deletion actually endangered -- is repaired to 0 broken references.

notes_for_orchestrator: Phase 4's post-deletion build returned exit 1 with 9 errors, ALL in FormalSystem/Metalogic/BaseLanguageSoundness.lean, inside a then-uncommitted +132-line block added by a concurrent session and referencing swapBL_involution, an identifier that did not exist at HEAD. That file has zero FrameConditions references. The session subsequently committed a compiling state and Phase 7's re-run is green. No action needed.
The plan's C6 warning was correct and was honoured: FrameConditions was REACHABLE, so no manifest entry was added. Adding one would have failed C6.
Brief item (b), the ValidOver/ValidLinear/... vocabulary, was confirmed already deleted by e5a9ba40f and was not re-done, as instructed.

Two adjacent pre-existing broken #leansrc pointers at typst/FormalFoundations.typ:1253-1254 were repaired alongside the planned repoints so the algebraic-soundness citation quad is coherent. This is the one place the implementation went slightly beyond the plan's enumerated scope; it is annotated as a deviation in both the plan and the summary.

37 further #leansrc (module, symbol) pairs in typst/FormalFoundations.typ do not resolve literally against the named module. Most appear to use an aggregator-module convention (e.g. Semantics for Semantics/TaskFrame.lean) rather than being broken, but some look genuinely stale (Metalogic.BXCanonical.Chronicle names a module that does not exist). This is pre-existing, unrelated to FrameConditions, and out of scope here -- it may be worth a task.
